description: Non-rendered capability scope records. These describe documentation work that is defined but deliberately not yet written, and the conditions under which a record must convert into published disclosure. Nothing here is published to the documentation site. The two LES records it once held were retired when those defects were fixed; the RANS record below is current.

records.rationale: The selector is reachable and the defect is total, so it is disclosed at every surface that offers it rather than deferred.
defect_summary: Setup allocates Nu_t for RANS but never allocates the K_Omega or K_Omega_o fields; the allocation site is a comment.
FlowSolver's RANS block, including the call to the transport update, is commented out, and K_Omega_Set_Constant is defined nowhere.
UpdateSolverHistoryVectors copies K_Omega into K_Omega_o whenever RANS is on, so the first call copies a null vector and PETSc aborts with a null-argument error at the end of step one.

code_anchors: src/setup.c (turbulence allocation: 'Add K_Omega etc. here as needed')
evidence.reproduced_by: A three-step, two-rank run of the flat_channel template with rans.enabled: true and model: k_omega on 2026-09-18 aborted in UpdateSolverHistoryVectors at src/runloop.c:339.
evidence.note: Confirmed by reading the implementation and by the run above.

activation_condition.trigger: The k-omega fields are allocated and the transport update is implemented.
activation_condition.required_action: Retire this record, return turbulence.rans and k_omega to experimental, and replace the disclosures with a limitations statement.
